name: Stormwind Army
summary: Across the southern kingdom, the Stormwind Army struggles to guard its lands and the Grand Alliance. Its knights and marshals are famed for resilience, yet the king is missing, nobles quarrel, and too few soldiers hold the provinces.

sections.title: A Legacy of Iron and Blood
sections.body: For centuries, Stormwind's army has fought gnolls on the frontier and Gurubashi trolls in desperate battles. In the First War, King Llane Wrynn I and Sir Anduin Lothar led the Knights of Stormwind in famed ambushes against the Orcish Horde. Yet fire took the capital. Survivors fled to Lordaeron, helped form the Alliance of Lordaeron, and fought through the Second War. After the Dark Portal fell, the restored kingdom raised its military anew.

sections.title: Structure and Ranks
sections.body: Stormwind Keep holds the army's command, and regional garrisons answer to the Stormwind Marshals. Within the capital, the Stormwind City Guard keeps civil order. The elite Royal Guard protects the boy-king Anduin Wrynn and Highlord Bolvar Fordragon. Beyond the gates, outposts patrol Elwynn Forest, watch the trade roads, and man ramparts as far as the Redridge Mountains. On the water, the Stormwind Fleet supports the army.

sections.title: A Thin Blue Line
sections.body:
The Stormwind Army is stretched thin, despite its proud traditions. The House of Nobles took on debts to extend its reach into Stranglethorn. Those debts deepened a bitter rift with the Stonemasons Guild. Civil riots followed, and the Defias Brotherhood was born.

With King Varian missing, the House of Nobles has often withheld troops, funds, and supplies from settlements such as Westfall, Lakeshire, and Duskwood. Local marshals turn to wandering adventurers to shoulder the realm's burdens.

faq.q: Why aren't more troops sent to Lakeshire and Sentinel Hill?
faq.answer: Stormwind's forces are stretched thin, and provincial pleas for reinforcements go unanswered. Westfall depends on the People's Militia, while royal soldiers in Lakeshire survived the loss of Stonewatch Keep. With few defenders and supplies running low, officers ask traveling adventurers for help.

faq.q: What is the difference between the Stormwind Army and the Stormwind Guard?
faq.answer: The Stormwind Army is the kingdom's wider military, with frontier marshals, garrisons, and knights serving across its lands. The Stormwind Guard enforces the law, patrols streets, and defends gates in Stormwind City and nearby rural hubs.

faq.q: Who commands the Stormwind Army right now?
faq.answer: With King Varian Wrynn missing, the boy-king Anduin Wrynn holds official military authority, guided by Regent Highlord Bolvar Fordragon. The House of Nobles often contests and undermines their strategic choices.

faq.q: Why do marshals give out deputy badges to adventurers?
faq.answer: Stormwind's army lacks soldiers, and the capital denies regional marshals reinforcements. McBride in Northshire and Dughan in Goldshire grant competent outsiders acting deputy status, so they can lawfully fight outlaws and defend the borders.

faq.q: What happened to the army during the First War?
faq.answer: Sir Anduin Lothar led the army in disciplined cavalry strikes that held the Orcish Horde at bay. But after King Llane was assassinated, the army was overwhelmed. Lothar led surviving soldiers and civilians across the Great Sea to Lordaeron, where the veterans formed the heart of the original Alliance forces.

faq.q: Where does the army currently maintain active garrisons?
faq.answer: The army keeps formal garrisons across Elwynn Forest, including Northshire, Goldshire, and Westbrook Garrison. Westfall and Duskwood depend on local militias. Soldiers remain in Lakeshire after the loss of Stonewatch Keep, waiting for reinforcements.

angles.text: As a human warrior, you can look to the Knights of Stormwind and Lothar's infantry as models of disciplined service. Many soldiers still struggle with the nobility's abandonment of the frontier.
As a paladin, you see the army's heavy cavalry and leaders work alongside the Order of the Silver Hand and Highlord Bolvar Fordragon to bring the Light's justice to lawless lands.
With Lordaeron shattered by the Scourge, Stormwind's army forms the Grand Alliance's main defense in the Eastern Kingdoms.
As a human of Stormwind, you know the royal army as a lasting sign of survival against impossible odds, and as a reminder of neglect in distant hamlets.
